subject: Commercial: Commit accordion and spike absorber framework
messages:
From: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@atlasfin.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Keele <t.keele@atlasfin.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RFP commercial clarifications — commits & spikes

Camila,

Thanks for taking the RFP. A couple of quick clarifications on the commercial section so we can land internal approval:

1) Commit structure — we asked for a 12-month committed token volume. Can you confirm whether you support automatically ramping a commit mid-term (we'd prefer an approach that avoids a manual amendment if we scale quickly).

2) Spikes — our usage for earnings periods can see 4–6x spikes for 48–72 hours after new feature launches. We want a mechanism that prevents astronomical overage bills while keeping incentives aligned.

3) True-up cadence — Atlas prefers quarterly true-ups. Any minimums or lookback windows we should expect?

I've attached the commercial section of our RFP for reference. Can you respond with a short proposed construct and any sample numbers? We need a one-pager that the procurement committee can take to the VP of Finance.

Best,
Samantha Holt
Procurement Manager
Atlas Financial
[Attachment: Atlas_RFP_Commercial_Section.pdf (pdf)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Tom Keele <t.keele@atlasfin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP commercial clarifications — commits & spikes

Samantha — thanks for the clear asks. High level response below; attaching a spreadsheet with worked examples (monthly token curves and net spend) and a short term sheet.

Summary proposal (high level) — see attached Redwood_Commit_Accordion_v1.xlsx

- Commit Accordion: Start with a 12-month baseline commit (monthly committed tokens). We allow a one-time automated upward accordion during the first 6 months (customer can opt-in to automatic tier expansion when 70% of monthly commit is reached for 3 consecutive days). Expansion is applied at a pre-negotiated incremental price (e.g., baseline price band remains; newly expanded tokens priced at baseline * 0.95 to reflect incremental discount). This avoids an amendment for predictable growth.

- Spike Absorber: For short-duration (<=72h) bursts above 3x baseline daily rate, Redwood grants a Spike Credit pool equal to 10% of the annual commit in token-equivalent (applied only twice per contract year), plus a time-limited accelerated true-up forgiveness that caps the billable overage for those events at 25% above baseline per-token rate. Additional spike usage is billed at overage rates (see sheet).

- Overage & True-up: Quarter cadence true-up is supported. Overage pricing is tiered: 1) up to 120% of committed monthly volume: baseline overage rate (baseline price * 1.15); 2) 120–200%: elevated rate (baseline price * 1.6); 3) >200%: spot surcharge (baseline price * 3.0). Quarterly true-up includes lookback of 90 days for smoothing; customer receives invoice credits or debits accordingly.

- Credits & Protections: We can apply a 60-day grace drawdown for pilot months (one-time) and provide a rolling 30-day notice before applying any permanent commit increases.

Numbers: The attached sheet uses an example baseline at 50M tokens/month with a baseline effective price of $2.20 per million tokens ($0.0022 per 1k tokens). With the Spike Absorber and Accordion in place, net expected spend volatility is reduced by ~40% in the example scenarios.

I'll leave the finer legal language to Marissa and Ben; want to check internal margins before we give a formal term sheet. Are you available for a 30-minute call on Monday to walk procurement through the concept?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Commit_Accordion_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 13:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP commercial clarifications — commits & spikes

Camila — quick internal thread before we present.

Notes / negotiation points: 
- The 10% Spike Credit pool looks okay but let's make it two-tiered: 10% unconditional credit + an optional purchase of an extra 15% absorber at a discounted prepay rate (gives Atlas flexibility for a known big launch window).
- Overages: I think the top-tier surcharge (3.0x) is aggressive and defensible only if we cap liability exposure. Suggest we include a soft cap on quarterly exposure (e.g., no more than 200% of committed spend per quarter unless specifically approved). That keeps finance comfortable.
- Accordion pricing: incremental expansion priced at baseline * 0.95 — ok but require a 30-day minimum on any expansion to avoid flip-flop behavior.
- Billing ops: require clear reporting (daily token burn feed + 24h delay) to trigger the accordion. Ben, can you confirm whether our runtime can emit the 24h token delta feed easily?

If we agree, we can tidy language and send to Samantha with a worked example showing a 3-month post-launch spike and the invoice math.

-Marissa
VP Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP commercial clarifications — commits & spikes

Marissa / Camila — quick tech confirm: yes, we can provide a near-real-time daily token burn feed (UTC rollover) and an hourly rolling 72-hour window metric. Emission is via a secure S3 drop (or webhook) — either works for procurement. I recommend S3 for auditability.

Also: suggest we offer a conservative alternative to the 3.0x surcharge: make >200% usage bill at spot GPU-backed rate (we'll provide a separate schedule) rather than a flat multiplier — gives procurement clearer next-step procurement math.

I'll prepare an updated spreadsheet with: 1) 10% + optional 15% prepay absorber, 2) quarterly exposure cap at 200% of committed spend, 3) accordion minimum 30-day duration, and 4) alternative >200% spot schedule. Sending in an hour for Camila to review.

-Ben
Strategic Pricing
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SpikeAbsorber_Terms.pdf (pdf)]
